messages:
maria.partnerships: Hey team — NebulaCloud sent final asset pack for marketplace listing + co-marketing. Can we do a fast pass this AM? Need checks on: logo lockups (horizontal + stacked + favicon), partner quote (one-liner), microcopy for CTA buttons, alt text for hero, and legal OK on 'Powered by Redwood Inference' mention. Link: https://nebula.cloud/asset-pack.zip

jake.marketing: On it. I'll do CTA variants and the one-liner. ETA 2 hours :thumbsup:

devon.design: Downloading now. Quick flag — partner provided a purple gradient bg that breaks our logo clearspace. I'll mock 2 alternatives.

lex.legal: Need to see the partner-signed logo usage. Do we have a digital asset license? Also the 'Powered by' phrase — does Nebula insist? That phrase can imply endorsement.

maria.partnerships: @lex.legal they attached an email thread that looks like consent but not the formal appendix. I'll forward here. If we need signature we should ping them.

jake.marketing: CTA options I like: 
```
1) Try Nebula + Redwood
2) Launch with Nebula Cloud
3) Explore Nebula templates
```
Which tone is preferred? "Launch with" = product-y, "Try" = quick trial.

devon.design: For alt text suggestions for the hero image: "Developer dashboard showing NebulaCloud template with Redwood Inference latency graph." Short and descriptive.

brand-checker-bot: Automated check results: logo clearspace - FAIL (stacked on gradient); color contrast for secondary CTA - FAIL (#6a2f7c on white); favicon size - OK

devon.design: I'll provide a flattened logo on white bg and a monochrome mark for dark bg. Also pushing a small hero crop with higher contrast.

lex.legal: If partner quote includes company name and claim, we need their written approval. Example quote they sent: "Redwood made Nebula's inference 3x faster" — need substantiation or change to neutral "improved inference latency". Also confirm they own the right to use stats.

maria.partnerships: @jake.marketing can you confirm with Nebula if they're comfortable with neutral phrasing? I'll ask for signed quote approval.

jake.marketing: Confirmed via DM — they'll revise to "reduced inference latency" and send a signed quote PDF by EOD. Also they prefer CTA 2) "Launch with Nebula Cloud" :+1:

devon.design: Uploaded revised assets to drive: https://rwd.co/nebula-assets — updated logos and alt text. Also included a small CSS snippet for button styles.

devon.design: ```css
.btn-cta { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ff6a00,#ff4500); color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 6px; }
``` 

maria.partnerships: Great. Once lex confirms license and the signed quote lands, we'll greenlight publishing to the marketplace. Thanks all :rocket:

lex.legal: Will review the license and the revised quote PDF when it comes in. If everything is in order, legal OK for marketplace and co-marketing. If not, we'll request the formal trademark & logo use addendum.

jake.marketing: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and share for a final quick review before publish.

maria.partnerships: Closing loop — tagging @nebula-ops contact to expect the final draft. cc: @jake.marketing @lex.legal
